articles.title: Binance to launch tokenized IPO program after regulatory approval: Yi He
articles.snippet: Binance is hiring for equity capital markets roles, including an analyst to develop tokenized equity products and assess prospective issuers.

articles.title: Bitcoin supply metric hits 11-year low as new ‘capitulation’ signal arrives
articles.snippet: The seven-day moving average of Bitcoin’s supply profit/loss ratio hit an 11-year low as BTC price losses month-to-date remain near 20%.
